name: Joint Optimization of Camera Pose and Decomposed Low-Rank Tensorial Radiance Fields
definition: An algorithm for joint refinement of camera pose and scene geometry represented by decomposed low-rank tensor, using only 2D images as supervision, addressing the issue where naive joint optimization on voxel-based NeRFs leads to suboptimal solutions due to lack of spectral bias.
summary: Joint TensoRF jointly refines camera poses and decomposed low-rank tensor radiance fields using spectral filtering to avoid local optima, unlike TensoRF which assumes known poses.
